==Description==
The '''Eggphone''' was a gear published to the Roblox catalog on the 6th of April 2020, specifically for the Roblox event, [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] As Tower Defense Simulator was part of this event, this gear had some use in the game. It can still be bought for free from the Roblox catalog, but it is no longer usable in Tower Defense Simulator.

==Usage==
This gear could only be used in Tower Defense Simulator during the Roblox event, [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] Using the '''Eggphone''', you could read egg descriptions to learn how to obtain other eggs in other games, as well as Tower Defense Simulator. You could also keep track of all the eggs you have obtained. This did not teleport you to other games.

==Trivia==
*The '''Eggphone''' could not actually be equipped in the game.
**The icon of the '''Eggphone''' was accidently set as its tooltip. This meant that the GUI always appeared to the right of the screen.
***If you wanted to use the '''Eggphone''', you had to click the GUI instead.
*The '''Eggphone''' could only be used in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby between the 6th of April 2020, and the 29th of April 2020.
**After 29 April 2020, the '''Eggphone''' could no longer be used, although the [[Spring 2020 Event]] still continued.
*Despite the [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] event ending on the 29th of April 2020, you can still buy the '''Eggphone''' from the Roblox catalog for free.
**You can still use the '''Eggphone''' in other games that allow for it, although it no longer has a function.
*'''Eggphone''' is a compound word of "egg" and "phone".
